checkpoints.description: [1/4] AIKit integration: attach project, seed .aikit memory, ledger plan and ADRs

impact_assessment.why: Postbox was created as an unattached scratch project; the user asked to make it AIKit-compatible and properly production-quality.
impact_assessment.benefits: Own git repo plus .aikit memory, gated delivery, explicit decisions, and a cold-start path for future work.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: persisted JSONL format must stay readable and versioned; dependency: stdlib only, no new packages; concurrency: threaded server appends must not interleave; state: append/clear atomicity and retention bounds must not lose captured requests.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a format version with refuse-on-unknown and a migration hook; lock every write; fsync each append; atomic os.replace for clear; failing-first tests per behaviour; run project check before any commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Hardened core: versioned append-only JSONL with refuse-on-unknown and in-memory migration, fsynced appends, atomic clear, retention cap, bounded request bodies, concurrency-safe writes
[3/4] Proper CLI: JSON output, method/path filters, limit, health endpoint, Why/Fix diagnostics, 21 failing-first tests covering versioning, migration, retention, concurrency, 413 and CLI
[4/4] Phase 4 passed: codebase map regenerated, ADR-001/002 recorded, AL-1.1 license and topics set, cold-start README verified; 4/4 gates green (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, 21 tests)

handoff.state: all gates pass, tree uncommitted per PRINCIPLE-018 R1
handoff.next: commit the untracked project files when the user authorizes, then run check --strict
